observations: Four green server-grade RAM modules are shown in multiple photos, arranged vertically in photos 0 and 2, and one module is shown alone in photo 1.
Each module has two white labels: one from SK hynix (left) and one from HP (right).
The SK hynix label reads: '32GB 2Rx4 PC4-2400T-RB2-11', 'HMA84GR7AFR4N-UH TD AC', '1640', and includes a CE mark and QR code.
The HP label includes part numbers like 'CT-RY7N604CC553H', 'P/N: 809643-071', and 'MAJORE', 'HALCYRE', 'R1JL88' on different modules.
The modules have 288-pin connectors, typical for server RAM.
Photo 1 shows a single module placed on a black ribbed surface, likely a server chassis or heatsink.
All modules appear physically identical in design and labeling.
No visible damage, bends, or missing components are seen on the modules.
